$comment: Movement classes (ruleset v0): how each class meets the ground and water. Cost of a cell = (baseCost + slopeCost * slope / 1000) * 1000 / speed, slope in permille (rise over run, 1000 = 45 degrees), speed in permille = water speed by depth (mm) x mud speed by mud (0-65535); steeper than maxSlopePermille is impassable, and so is water deeper than maxEnterDepthMm or water that sweeps the class (at least sweptDepthMm deep, or at least sweptMinDepthMm deep with depth x flow speed (mm x mm/s / 1000) at least sweptDepthSpeed). Slope numbers are placeholders for spec pass S2; the water and mud numbers are spec S1, section 3 and 6 (settled 2026-11-03). Field-driven costs refresh every fieldCostRefreshTicks (40 = every 2 s: S1 allows at most 1 Hz, and 2 s keeps a cast edit's refill inside the preview budget, plan section 8), and a cell's stored speed changes only when some class crosses swept or closed or its speed moves by fieldCostHysteresisPermille of full speed (S1 section 3: cost hysteresis; 100 = 10%, a placeholder tuned for the preview's refill time). Swept soldiers drift at carriedPermille of the flow, paddle toward footing at paddleMmPerS, drown after drowningTicks and regain footing below regainPermille of every threshold (S1 section 4). The water class's water response is inert; the class itself stays impassable until boats exist.
